name: serverasmcp
description: MCP server that gives AI agents unrestricted root SSH access to unlimited Linux servers. Execute any command, deploy files, configure Cloudflare DNS, and self-heal deployments until production is live.
longDescription: ServerAsMcp is a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that lets AI agents (Codex, Claude, Cursor, etc.) connect to and control unlimited remote Linux servers over SSH. Define servers via SERVER_N_HOST/SERVER_N_PASSWORD env vars, and your agent can execute any shell command as root, upload files via SFTP, configure Cloudflare DNS to make apps publicly live, and run a self-healing deployment loop that reads logs, diagnoses errors, fixes them, and retries until production is confirmed. Includes a built-in deployment skill (get_skill tool) that teaches the agent the full 7-phase workflow: server registration, Git detection, runtime installation, application deployment, systemd service configuration, Cloudflare DNS setup, and production verification.
